name: mount-diablo-summit-window
description: Terrain for the "mount-diablo-summit" ground-truth acceptance case: a 361x397 rectangle of real SRTM1 data cut byte-for-byte out of N37W122. Committed so the acceptance suite runs offline without data/tiles/, which is gitignored.
coverageNote: Covers the summit and 5 km of its slopes. Every must-see peak in this case is 60-292 km away, so this window can only prove that nothing WITHIN 5 KM hides them — it says nothing about the Diablo Range at 25 km. The case's own header argues that ridge line analytically.

source.dataset: SRTM1 (1 arc-second) via the AWS elevation-tiles-prod "skadi" mirror
source.license: SRTM is public domain (NASA/USGS); the AWS mirror is a public dataset.

accuracyCaveat: Terrain horizon only. SRTM under-reads AND displaces sharp summits (Matterhorn 4230 m here against a surveyed 4478 m, ~320 m out of position), so summit heights come from the peak database in fixtures/peaks/, never from these bytes.
